title: leucostele coquimbana
intro: Leucostele coquimbana, commonly known as the Queen of the Andes or Queen of the Mountain, is a species of cactus in the genus Leucostele. This plant is known for its vibrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Leucostele coquimbana include its use as an expectorant and bronchodilator, helping to relieve congestion and improve breathing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
